1. The Top Detector (Leading Indicator): Powered by an 80/20 Proportional/Linear Split. This metric is hyper-sensitive to price velocity. It identifies "blow-off tops" early by measuring how fast price is stretching away from the 20-week SMA. The Price dots are color-coded by risk intensity (Blue = Safe, Red = Dangerous).
2. The Bottom Detector (Trailing Indicator): Powered by a Rolling 365-Day Z-Score mapped to a Cumulative Distribution Function. This mathematically isolates bottoms in "boring" markets. When volatility dies during deep bear markets, the internal bands tighten, allowing even subtle capitulation moves to accurately trigger a deep-value "Green Zone" buy signal.
3. The Composite (Hybrid Consensus): The mathematical average of Chart 1 and Chart 2. This creates a balanced macro view by removing the noise of the Leading indicator and the lag of the Trailing indicator. Use this as your primary "Traffic Light" system for systemic accumulation (Green/Blue) versus distribution (Orange/Red).
